scenicChapters.title: Tihău - Dealul Cucului → Treznea-Coasta Ciungii 2
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-salva-modrut-treznea-coasta-ciung.story: A 278 km round trip from Nimigea de Sus - roughly 4 h 48 in the saddle. On the way it passes Dumbrăveni - Dealul Podului 1, Glod - Toaca Glodului 1, Tihău - Dealul Cucului and Treznea-Coasta Ciungii 2. The coast is the point of it.

places-fuente-del-sabuco-ii-cueva-de-la-.story: From Nerpio it runs 247 km to Nerpio; allow about 4 h 16 of riding. The stops in between: Cañada de la Cruz, Cueva de la Hiedra and back through Cañada de la Cruz. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
